create_DotWall_env: create a DotWall gym environment with a WallDatasetConfig for two-room navigation tasks
reset_DotWall: reset the DotWall environment to generate a new wall layout and start position
step_DotWall: step the DotWall environment forward with a 2D action array and get observations
eval_state_DotWall: evaluate DotWall agent success by comparing goal and current dot positions with a threshold
coord_to_pixel_DotWall: render batched dot locations as image tensors with walls without modifying environment state
